As published annually in the New Mexico Hunting Migratory Game Bird Supplement Booklet.
November 10-February 28 - 1/2 Hour Before Sunrise to 1/2 Hour After Sunset; Daily. March 1-November 9 - 7:00 am to 1/2 Hour After Sunset; Monday-Friday.
1/2 Hour Before Sunrise to 1/2 Hour After Sunset; Daily
Allowed on auto tour route and in designated parking areas only.
Bernardo Wildlife Area has restrooms but not drinking water.
Fishing is allowed March 15 - September 9 along irrigation canals when filled with water.
Part of the Ladd S. Gordon Waterfowl Complex, Bernardo Wildlife Area is located between Belen and Socorro between I-25 and the Rio Grande.

Hunters and anglers need a Habitat Management and Access Validation (HMAV) plus the proper license, valid on the dates published for this property in the NM Hunting & Fishing Rules and Information. Each licensed hunter may bring up to three guests.

Entering land not designated for access, or a closed area, is unlawful. Licensed hunters and up to three guests are exempt from closures during their published hunt, and big game hunters during a 7-day scouting period before it.

No vehicles off established roads or on closed roads. No camping over 14 consecutive days (licensed hunters may camp through their hunt/scouting period).

Dogs and pets must be leashed, except dogs used for hunting during published hunts where dogs are allowed by rule. Open fires must be safely contained; only pelleted/grain feed or certified weed-free hay.
No removing rocks, plants, firewood, animals or artifacts. Commercial activity needs a permit (registered outfitters excepted). [19.34.3.10 NMAC]
verdict: Hunters need a Habitat Management & Access Validation plus the right license, and may hunt only the seasons/hunts published for this property.

sections: Hunting: open; Fishing: not designated; Other recreation (GAIN): open

Authorized Activities and License Requirements HUNTING is allowed in accordance with the regulations and open seasons specified in the NMDGF Hunting Rules and Info, and the GENERAL RULES listed below. GENERAL OUTDOOR RECREATION activities are allowed outside of the Closures listed below. Each group of up to 4 adults must possess at least 1 of the following: valid hunting license, fishing license, trapping license, or HMAV to participate in these activities. Youth 17 years old and younger do not require a HMAV. Suggested Activities: wildlife viewing, photography, hiking, and horseback riding. See closure details below.

Take I-40 exit 114 at Laguna onto Route 66. Travel 1.4 miles on Route 66 and turn right on NM-279/334. Travel 13.5 miles north on NM-279/334 and turn right onto CR-1. Travel 17.0 miles east on CR-1 and turn right onto easement access road (see map).
WMA is closed to access during WMA draw hunts for turkey, deer, and elk, except for individuals, and their guests, possessing valid draw licenses.

WMA is designated into Upper and Lower property sections for purposes of defining access for General Recreation activities (see map). All lands on upper portion of WMA closed to access November 15 through June 30. All lands on lower portion of WMA closed to access November 15 through May 15.
Open daily for General Recreation activities outside of closure periods listed above.
WMA is designated as day use only. No camping.
Motorized access not allowed beyond designated parking areas (see map).
All lands will remain open for General Recreation Activities during draw bear hunts.
Barbary sheep hunting is allowed on those days that the property is open to General Recreation Activities. Barbary sheep hunters must follow all other rules in Closures and Special Rules.
Camping is not allowed on the WMA.

Hunters and anglers need a Habitat Management and Access Validation (HMAV) plus the proper license, valid on the dates published for this property in the NM Hunting & Fishing Rules and Information. Each licensed hunter may bring up to three guests.

Entering land not designated for access, or a closed area, is unlawful. Licensed hunters and up to three guests are exempt from closures during their published hunt, and big game hunters during a 7-day scouting period before it.
Entering during published big game and waterfowl hunt dates is limited to licensed hunters (and guests) for that hunt, except in designated areas.
No vehicles off established roads or on closed roads. No camping over 14 consecutive days (licensed hunters may camp through their hunt/scouting period).

Dogs and pets must be leashed, except dogs used for hunting during published hunts where dogs are allowed by rule. Open fires must be safely contained; only pelleted/grain feed or certified weed-free hay.
No removing rocks, plants, firewood, animals or artifacts. Commercial activity needs a permit (registered outfitters excepted). [19.34.3.10 NMAC]
verdict: Hunters need a Habitat Management & Access Validation plus the right license, and may hunt only the seasons/hunts published for this property.
